hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was just a simple maid, sent to this grand inn for a new job. One evening, I was in the hall when I heard footsteps. I turned to see a lady brushing her hair, so delicate and beautiful. She offered me her handkerchief to help me lace my corset. I couldn't believe my luck. What a sweet gesture. What will she ask of me now?
caption:
I couldn't resist helping her. What do you think happened next?
